title: Quick Reference
intro: The syntax used across this topic, on one page. Square brackets mark optional parts.

blocks.source:
Title line (always the first line)
* comment        ; end-of-line comment after "$ ", ";" or "//"
.include file    .lib file section    .param name=value    .func f(x) {expr}
.subckt name n1 n2 params: p=1   ...   .ends
.model name type (param=value ...)
.options name=value    .temp 27    .global vdd
.ic v(n)=1    .nodeset v(n)=1
.control  ...  .endc
.end

Rname n+ n- value [m=] [tc1=] [tc2=] [noisy=0]        R=expr for behavioural
Cname n+ n- value [ic=]          C=expr or Q=expr        Lname n+ n- value [ic=]
Kname L1 L2 k
Vname n+ n- [DC v] [AC mag [ph]] [PULSE|SIN|EXP|PWL|SFFM|AM|TRNOISE|TRRANDOM(...)]
Iname n+ n- ...  (current flows n+ -> source -> n-)
Ename n+ n- nc+ nc- gain    Gname n+ n- nc+ nc- gm    Fname n+ n- Vsense gain    Hname n+ n- Vsense r
Bname n+ n- V=expr | I=expr
Dname a k model [area]    Qname c b e [s] model [area]    Jname d g s model
Mname d g s b model L= W= [AD= AS= PD= PS= m= nf=]
Sname n+ n- c+ c- model    Wname n+ n- Vsense model
Tname a1 a2 b1 b2 Z0= TD=    Oname ... ltra_model    Uname n1 n2 n3 urc_model
Xname nodes subckt [p=v]    Aname ports codemodel    Nname nodes osdi_model [params]

.op
.dc src start stop step [src2 start2 stop2 step2]      (src: V, I, R or TEMP)
.ac dec|oct|lin n fstart fstop
.tran tstep tstop [tstart [tmax]] [uic]
.noise v(out[,ref]) src dec n fstart fstop [pts_per_summary]
.disto dec n fstart fstop [f2overf1]
.pz in+ in- out+ out- vol|cur pol|zer|pz
.tf outvar src
.sens outvar [ac dec n fstart fstop]
.sp dec n fstart fstop [donoise]
.pss gfreq tstab node points harms [sciter steadycoeff] [uic]
.four f0 v(out)    .meas tran|ac|dc|sp name ...    .save vectors    .print tran v(out)

items: Accuracy: reltol=1e-3, abstol=1e-12, vntol=1e-6, chgtol=1e-14, trtol=7.
Convergence: gmin=1e-12, gminsteps, srcsteps, itl1=100, itl2=50, itl4=10, rshunt, noopiter, optran (command).
Solver: klu or sparse (noise and CIDER need sparse). num_threads (variable) for OpenMP.
Output: noinit, interp, savecurrents, numdgt, warn and maxwarns, temp and tnom, scale, acct.

blocks.source:
run  op  dc ...  ac ...  tran ...  noise ...  pz ...  tf ...  sens ...  sp ...  pss ...
let x = expr    set var = value    echo "text $var $&vector"    print v(out) > file
meas tran name trig ... targ ... | when ... | find ... at= | avg|rms|pp|min|max|integ ...
alter R1 2k    altermod nch vth0=0.4    alterparam p=1    reset    option reltol=1e-4
foreach v a b c ... end    while cond ... end    repeat n ... end    if cond ... else ... end
setplot [name]   display   destroy   save v(out) @m1[gm]   show m1   showmod nch
wrdata file vecs   write file.raw [vecs]   load file.raw   wrs2p file.s2p
plot v(out) vs v(in) xlog   gnuplot name vecs   pyplot name vecs   hardcopy file vecs
fourier f0 v(out)   linearize   fft v(out)   spec f1 f2 df v(out)   psd n v(out)
pre_osdi file.osdi   codemodel file.cm   source file.cir   remcirc   setseed n   quit

T=1e12  G=1e9  Meg=1e6  k=1e3  mil=25.4e-6  m=1e-3  u=1e-6  n=1e-9  p=1e-12  f=1e-15  a=1e-18. M is milli.
ngspice [-b] [-r raw] [-o log] [-n] [-a] [-i] [-s] [-D var=value] file.cir;  openvaf-r [-o out.osdi] [-I dir] [-D macro] [--target_cpu generic] model.va.
